nvitk.segmentation.eicab.runner
===============================

.. py:module:: nvitk.segmentation.eicab.runner

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Local eICAB inference via ``singularity run`` and optional output pruning.

---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.segmentation.eicab.runner.metric_scratch_bind_args

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: metric_scratch_bind_args(root: str | None = None) -> list[str]

   Singularity ``--bind`` args for VED metric_space + CWD on node-local scratch.


.. py:function:: metric_scratch_prep_shell(root: str | None = None) -> str

   Shell snippet: create node-local dirs for VED ``metric_space`` and CWD.


.. py:function:: metric_scratch_cleanup_shell(root: str | None = None) -> str

   Shell snippet: remove **only** this job's ``nvitk_eicab_<JOB_ID>`` dir.

   Guards:
   - rebuilds the path from scratch root + ``JOB_ID`` (no glob);
   - requires basename prefix ``nvitk_eicab_``;
   - refuses to delete the scratch root itself.


.. py:function:: segmentation_outputs_to_keep(out_dir: pathlib.Path) -> list[pathlib.Path]

   Pick CoW, whole-brain, and ``*_resampled`` NIfTIs; drop other intermediates.


.. py:function:: prune_eicab_outputs(out_dir: pathlib.Path, *, keep_aux_outputs: bool, keep_paths: Iterable[pathlib.Path] | None = None) -> None

   Drop auxiliary folders/files unless *keep_aux_outputs* is True.


.. py:function:: build_eicab_singularity_argv(input_nii: str | pathlib.Path, output_dir: str | pathlib.Path, *, tmp_dir: str | pathlib.Path, container: str | pathlib.Path, resolution: float = 0.625, simple_segmentation: bool = False, attention: bool = False, device: str = 'cpu', vasculature_host_path: str | pathlib.Path | None = None) -> list[str]

   Build ``singularity run`` argv for eICAB on the cluster host (host paths).


.. py:function:: run_eicab(input_nii: str | pathlib.Path, output_dir: str | pathlib.Path, *, resolution: float = 0.625, simple_segmentation: bool = False, attention: bool = False, device: str = 'cpu', container: str | pathlib.Path, tmp_dir: str | pathlib.Path, keep_aux_outputs: bool = False, vasculature_host_path: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, check: bool = True, capture_output: bool = True) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]

   Run eICAB via ``singularity run`` (same contract as legacy BioImaging).

   *vasculature_host_path* should be the **host** directory bind-mounted to
   ``/programs/Neuro/vasculature2`` (see ``run_eicab_inference.sh``). When
   omitted and the path does not exist, the vasculature bind is skipped (only
   sensible for debugging).
